4.Detial: Estrilda can boost morale, increasing allies' Attack Rating and recovering Energy. Her Signature Item Skill can also reduce damage taken by allies in the backline.
4.FriendDetial: Elijah & Lailah can also boost their allies' Attack Rating and recover Energy. As a reliable frontline Tank, Estrilda can enhance the survivability of Elijah & Lailah situated in the backline.

9.Detial: As his health decreases, Brutus receives a greater Attack Rating buff. When dealt a fatal blow, he becomes immune to damage for a longer period.
9.FriendDetial: When dealt a fatal blow, Brutus becomes invincible for a longer period, buying time for Skriath to cast Desert Vortex. Meanwhile, when Skriath uses a sandstorm vortex to gather enemies, Brutus' Whirlwind can hit more enemies.

16.Detial: At the start of battle, Lyca can boost the entire team's Haste and restore their Energy, giving her team the upper hand. She can also boost allies' Accuracy, and her attacks reduce the Defense Rating and Crit Block Rate of enemies.
16.FriendDetial: Zolrath has a special ability that prevents enemies from joining battle for a certain duration. When paired with Lyca, you'll gain a strong advantage early in the battle.

25.Detial: Not only is Grezhul able to continuously summon skeletal warriors that aid him in battle, he can also siphon off an enemy's Attack Rating. When facing a Boss, he can siphon off an even higher amount of Attack Rating.
25.FriendDetial: Elijah & Lailah can form a union between two heroes, boosting the Attack of one hero based on the Attack of the other. When a union is formed with Grezhul, you can have two powerful heroes with a high Attack Rating at the same time.

32.Detial: Thoran can be resurrected once per battle. His Ultimate can be charged up, during which incoming damage is reflected back to the attacker. During the first Ultimate after unlocking his Signature Item's skill, he cannot be defeated while charging.
32.FriendDetial: Flora will remain airborne as long as there is another surviving ally on the battlefield. Thoran's high survivability allows Flora to remain airborne while she provides steady damage output and healing.

34.Detial: Raine marks the weakest enemy hero so that an ally receives additional buffs and deals more damage when attacking the hero. Her Signature Item is able to continuously restore the health and Energy of her ally with the highest Combat Rating and provide them with a shield.
34.FriendDetial: Raine's Signature Item is able to continuously restore the health and Energy of her ally with the highest Combat Rating and provide them with a shield, while also enhancing Belinda - Spark of Hope's survivability and frequency of Cleansing Flame.

38.Detial: Skreg's skill allows him to knock enemies into the air and back continuously. He is adept at moving the battle line forward and charging into the enemy half of the battlefield.
38.FriendDetial: Kren sets up mortar batteries at the back of the battlefield and bombards enemies continuously. Skreg moves the battle line forward, clustering enemies and creating an optimum bombarding environment for Kren.

48.Detial: Eironn can use magic to generate wind, pulling enemies in range and gathering them in front of him. This makes it easier for allies to hit more targets with their AoE skills.
48.FriendDetial: Skriath's Furniture Skill pulls upper and lower backline enemies, gathering them toward the center. This makes it easier for Eironn to pull more enemies.

52.Detial: Rowan can use his Ultimate and the potions he gains periodically to restore lots of Energy to allies. He can also provide buffs to healing and Attack Rating.
52.FriendDetial: Both Rosaline and Rowan can restore lots of Energy to allies. When fighting alongside one another, they can boost the Ultimate usage speed and frequency of ally heroes that rely on their Ultimates.

55.Detial: When the battle starts, Athalia dashes toward the enemy across from her, inflicting continuous damage and controls on the target. Make sure to place her in the correct position to attack core enemy heroes.
55.FriendDetial: Alna can periodically grant herself and another frontline hero immunity to damage and controls. Alna can absorb damage from the frontline, protecting Athalia as she dashes deep into the battlefield.

56.Detial: Ezizh provides steady and continuous Energy recovery for allies, and he can periodically prevent enemies from using their Ultimate. These traits make him a support hero with both controls and buffs.
56.FriendDetial: Ezizh provides steady and continuous Energy recovery for allies. This frequently triggers Belinda - Spark of Hope's Awakened Skill, allowing her to use her Ultimate more often.

59.Detial: When Mehira uses her Ultimate, she charms all enemies in front of her, causing them to attack their own allies. She also summons 3 minions that attack automatically. When Mehira takes fatal damage, the minions sacrifice themselves to restore her health.
59.FriendDetial: Khazard increases the duration of debuffs on enemies, allowing Mehira to keep them charmed for longer.

61.Detial: During battle, Rosaline follows an ally as they move, boosting their attributes (such as Attack Rating) while also inflicting damage and controls on nearby enemies. Her Ultimate will also restore max Energy for the followed ally.
61.FriendDetial: Both Rowan and Rosaline can restore lots of Energy to allies. When fighting alongside one another, they can boost the Ultimate usage speed and frequency of ally heroes that rely on their Ultimates.

62.Detial: Elijah & Lailah can form a bond with another hero, boosting that hero's Attack Rating based on their own Attack Rating. Elijah & Lailah's Ultimate grants the entire team a Haste boost and immunity to controls.
62.FriendDetial: Grezhul can steal Attack Rating from enemies, and he can steal even more from bosses. When a bond is formed with Grezhul, you can have two heroes with high Attack Rating at the same time.

63.Detial: Injected Fury of Silas renders an ally immune to all damage for 8 seconds while increasing their Attack Rating. At the end of the skill, he loses health equal to the total damage taken during the skill but without dying. Once his Furniture Skill is unlocked, he can further increase the same ally's normal attack damage and frequency.
63.FriendDetial: During a battle, Grezhul constantly steals enemies' Attack Rating. Silas can increase his Attack Rating massively and enhances his survivability.

64.Detial: Zolrath is able to delay enemies from joining the battle while continuously boosting his own damage output over time. In case of defeat, he can even rewind and fight again.
64.FriendDetial: Lyca can provide a team-wide boost at the start of the battle, increasing their Haste and restoring their Energy. When paired with Zolrath, they can give an edge to the team at the early stages of the battle.

67.Detial: As energy accumulates, Oden will continuously awaken and become stronger in battle, providing steady damage output during long fights. His Ultimate skill can destroy all of the enemy's Energy, limiting their abilities.
67.FriendDetial: A dependable frontline fighter, Alna is able to hold off the enemy long enough for Oden to fully awaken.

73.Detial: Talene heals allies when she loses health, and she has the power to resurrect herself. Position her in the right location to sacrifice her and allow the team to survive forceful enemy attacks, then resurrect her so she can join her allies in the counterattack.
73.FriendDetial: Tidus has a tendency to be slain in the first wave of enemy attacks, before Savagery can be triggered. Talene can help Tidus survive until a weakened enemy appears, allowing him to use Savagery to harvest their health.

74.Detial: After Saurus finishes using a skill, the cooldowns of his other skills are refreshed and he gains Attack Rating and Defense Rating. After using the Ultimate, his skills will create a phantom that uses the same skill, greatly increasing his damage output.
74.FriendDetial: Elijah & Lailah's Ultimate grants the entire team a Haste boost and immunity to controls, allowing Saurus to finish using skills faster.

76.Detial: Khazard increases the duration of debuffs on enemies, and his Ultimate changes the weather on the battlefield to Frozen Mist, inflicting continuous damage on enemies and reducing their recovery. This can also Freeze enemies with low health.
76.FriendDetial: Mehira can charm enemies, causing them to attack their own allies. Khazard increases the duration of debuffs on enemies, allowing Mehira to keep them charmed for longer.

83.Detial: The Desert Vortex of Skriath can summon a sandstorm vortex that gathers up the enemies, while his Furniture Skill can lead enemies in the enemy backline to its center, making it easier to cluster the enemies.
83.FriendDetial: Eironn can use his elemental powers to generate a powerful gust of wind that draws in enemies toward his front. When assisted by Skriath's sandstorm vortex, he can cluster enemies more easily and deal destructive damage to them.

90.Detial: Daimon can create a shield by pilfering the health of his enemies. With signature gear, he can also pilfer their Attack Ratings and Defense Ratings at the same time. This skill enables him to both act as a frontline tank and deal considerable damage to enemies.
90.FriendDetial: Rowan can restore Energy to allies and increase the frequency of Daimon's Ultimate skill, further enhancing Daimon's dual capability as a Tank and damage dealer.

93.Detial: In battle, Lucretia will pursue the enemy with the highest Attack Rating. When teammates fall, she gains a stackable Attack buff. Her Ultimate skill can damage surrounding enemies and limit their Energy recovery as well as usage of Ultimate skills.
93.FriendDetial: Eironn can pull in enemies within a certain range and bring them together in front of him. When an ally perishes, Lucretia can deal massive damage to the gathered enemies with her high Attack Rating and Ultimate skill.

99.Detial: Mortas' Ultimate enhances the ally with the highest Attack Rating, boosting their attributes (such as Attack Rating) and allowing their normal attacks to steal enemies' health and shields. He can also cause enemies to transfer recovery effects they receive to himself.
99.FriendDetial: Baden, the Knight of Blight, can convert healing effects received by enemies into damage, allowing Mortas to convert enemies' recovered health into massive damage.

102.Detial: Alna has many skills that can slow down enemies, while her Furniture Skill grants her and another frontline hero immunity to damage and control effects at regular intervals, making her a dependable frontline fighter.
102.FriendDetial: Alna's Furniture Skill creates an environment that favors Baden - Knight of Blight's survival, enabling him to make the most of his ability to create multiple doubles.

103.Detial: Kren's Bomb Voyage allows him to set up a mortar battery at the back of the allied half of the battlefield, bombarding enemies continuously. His Signature Item Skill can also strengthen his normal attack and Bomb Voyage, dealing greater damage and additional control effects.
103.FriendDetial: Skreg can move the battle line forward and knock back enemies, triggering landmines buried by Kren, and create an optimum bombarding environment for Kren situated in the backline.

106.Detial: Raku increases the damage taken by enemies under control effects, and his normal attacks hit such enemies more often. His Signature Item skill causes his normal attacks to deal extra damage based on the target's current health.
106.FriendDetial: Mishka's Ultimate provides long-lasting controls and Defense Rating reduction while increasing the damage taken by enemies. It also increases the number of targets that can be hit by the extra attacks from Raku's normal attacks.

120.Detial: Mishka's Ultimate provides long-lasting controls and Defense Rating reduction, and can also summon wolves that continuously bite and mark enemies while granting allies a damage boost. Mishka is an outstanding tank that provides controls and damage boosts.
120.FriendDetial: Raku deals extremely high damage to enemies under control effects. Paired with Mishka's controls and debuffs, Raku's damage is further increased.

121.Detial: Haelus can boost the shield value of allies with shields, while also granting them continuous Energy recovery and immunity to controls. His Ultimate summons obelisks that attack enemies and provides continuous shields to allies.
121.FriendDetial: Haelus can grant Belinda's Spark of Hope a shield and Energy recovery effects, boosting Belinda's survivability and damage output.

125.Detial: When the battle starts, Framton can teleport in front of the enemy across from him, using the engraving-upgrading effect of his skills to quickly gather enemies. He can then use his Ultimate to gather enemies continuously.
125.FriendDetial: After Framton gathers enemies, Maetria's flames will have a more devastating effect.

126.Detial: Astar casts Flame Seeds on enemies and detonates them subsequently, dealing AoE damage and healing allies. With Life Sparks she can shoot healing sparks and restore the health of allies within range. When her Signature Item is active, Life Sparks can also inflict AoE damage.
126.FriendDetial: Solise - Water Animator can convert excess healing into buffs for allies or additional damage to enemies. When joining forces with Astar, she can ensure the survivability of her team while dealing considerable damage.

127.Detial: Scarlet can absorb health from others and convert it to Energy, allowing her to quickly cast her Ultimate skill and debuffing effects. Her Ultimate skill's damage increases with each use.
127.FriendDetial: Elijah & Lailah's Ultimate skill can increase the Haste of allies and provide immunity to control effects, which not only speeds up the rate at which Scarlet uses her skills, but also offers her a certain degree of protection.

130.Detial: Upon entering a battlefield, Ezizh - Lord of Nightmares can put to sleep the enemy directly opposite him, while constantly controlling enemies, reducing their Tenacity, and boosting his allies' Tenacity. His Nightmare's Descent can also regularly restrict enemies from using their Ultimate skills. He is a Hypogean mage with formidable controlling abilities.
130.FriendDetial: Mezoth can control enemies for long periods while possessing strong survival abilities. He can provide Ezizh - Lord of Nightmares a more optimal environment for dealing damage and work with Ezizh in controlling enemies.

134.Detial: Thane -The Veiled Wind instantly attacks the enemy hero with the lowest health at the beginning of the battle, dealing massive burst damage. As an assassin hero, he is highly effective at countering the enemy backline.
134.FriendDetial: Zolrath's unique ability to delay the enemy from joining the battle, combined with Thane - The Veiled Wind's instantaneous attack, can deliver a deadly blow to the enemy backline right at the start of the battle.

136.Detial: Sonja grants her teammates Roses of various colors, which reduce the damage taken by them and inflicts health loss on their attackers. Her Signature Item grants a Thorned Aura to allies with a Gold Rose, which restores their health continuously while dealing damage to enemies.
136.FriendDetial: Hendrik has strong protective abilities and can join forces with Sonja to protect allies.

137.Detial: While on a battlefield, Anasta can receive Brawler's Protection, which grants her damage reduction and health recovery so as to boost her endurance. Her Furniture Skill provides her team of allies the same effect.
137.FriendDetial: Safiya - Maestro of Power can dole out Masks to her allies. When an ally uses their skill, she deals damage to enemies while recovering Energy. Anasta can use her skill at a high frequency, and so is able to trigger the effects of Masks frequently.

139.Detial: Brutus - Lion's Pride can absorb all the power stored in his shield and inflict health loss on enemies based on the absorbed value. The skill also deals both AoE damage and control effects.
139.FriendDetial: Merlin can provide allies with damage reduction, healing, and shields, ensuring Brutus - Lion's Pride's survival. The high shield value bestowed will also boost Brutus' damage output.

141.Detial: Eorin's spearhead attack applies Poisonous Mushroom to the enemy. By attacking enemies carrying this debuff, he continuously strengthens himself and deals additional damage while labeling the enemy with the highest Attack Rating with a Weakspot Mark, lowering their attributes. After killing the labeled enemy, he refreshes the mark.
141.FriendDetial: Eorin cut into the battlefield as the battle starts, when Lyca can also provide buffs to the whole team by boosting their Haste and Energy recovery, helping Eorin deal damage more effectively.

142.Detial: Tarnos can obtain a strong damage reduction at the start of battle, and inflict damage on enemies by continuously summoning the Pillar of Sin, while also moving between the pillars on the battlefield to disrupt enemy formations.
142.FriendDetial: Tarnos is well-suited for prolonged battles of attrition. The ample healing provided by Solise - Water Animator ensures the survivability of the team, allowing Tarnos to play a crucial role in the late stages of battle.

143.Detial: Solise - Water Animator fights alongside the water spirits she summons, offers powerful healing to allied heroes, and converts overhealed health into buffs for allied heroes or more damage to enemies.
143.FriendDetial: Nevanthi provides Attack and Haste buffs for summoners and summoned entities, and has various healing abilities that synergize well with Solise - Water Animator's skills.

146.Detial: The first time Canisa & Ruke take fatal damage, they recover full health and gain immunity to damage and controls for a certain duration. They can also share damage taken with an enemy. At the same time, they can gather and weaken enemies. Canisa & Ruke is a frontline tank with survivability and support capabilities.
146.FriendDetial: Duskfeather Maetria can use Smoldering Flame to deal continuous damage to the enemies gathered by Canisa & Ruke. Canisa & Ruke's powerful survivability also buys enough time for Duskfeather Maetria to absorb attributes and resurrect.

147.Detial: Nevanthi provides various Healing to her allies and can strengthen the summoners and their summoned entities among her allies, increasing their Attack Rating and Haste. She is a support hero with remarkable buff and protective abilities.
147.FriendDetial: On a battlefield, Solise - Water Animator can summon Water Spirits as reinforcements. Meanwhile, Nevanthi can provide Attack Rating, Haste, and other buffs to summoners and their summoned entities among her allies. Nevanthi is also a great healer capable of triggering Aqua Affinity of Solise - Water Animator constantly.

148.Detial: Baden - Knight of Blight has the skill to create doubles. If Baden perishes, he will be reincarnated in his wooden double. He can also immobilize and prevent the healing of enemies, while converting the healing they receive into damage.
148.FriendDetial: Mortas has a special enemy-healing ability, which deals massive damage when paired with Baden - Knight of Blight's skill, especially against enemies with strong health.

150.Detial: Palmer can continuously provide Attack, Crit, Magic Pierce, and Physical Pierce buffs to allies, while protecting the ally with the lowest health percentage by healing and sharing damage. He is a Support hero that combines buffs and protection capabilities.
150.FriendDetial: Belinda - Spark of Hope is a key damage dealer that benefits greatly from buffs to attributes such as Crit, Attack and Magic Pierce to deal huge damage. Buffs provided by Palmer significantly enhance Belinda's damage output.

151.Detial: Veithael gains extra max health at the start of battle. His Signature Item skill can convert this extra max health into a large Attack Rating bonus that he can grant to himself or allies.
151.FriendDetial: Tamrus can quickly gather enemies. When combined with the Attack Rating boost Veithael provides at the start of battle, the team will start off with an optimal environment for dealing damage.

152.Detial: Mulan performs a follow-up attack on enemies that are being knocked into the air or under other limitation effects. When using her Ultimate skill, she charges forward on her horse, dealing substantial damage to enemies and knocking them into the air.
152.FriendDetial: Tamrus has various skills that can control enemies or knock them into the air, triggering Mulan's follow-up attack. He can also gather enemies to fully take advantage of Mulan's AoE damage abilities.

153.Detial: Belinda - Spark of Hope's Ultimate skill possesses her with a Divine Flame, during which all damage she deals is Critical Strikes and ignores the enemy's Defense and Damage Reduction, making her a powerful high-burst damage dealer.
153.FriendDetial: Attack, Crit, Magic Pierce and other stat buffs provided by Palmer significantly enhance Belinda's damage output.

154.Detial: Tamrus can quickly cut into crowded areas of the battlefield and gather enemies there. He gains Enthusiasm based on the number of enemies nearby, increasing his Dodge and Magic Suppression. His Exclusive Furniture can cause the entire team to benefit from this effect.
154.FriendDetial: Veithael can grant allies a large Attack Rating bonus at the start of battle. When combined with Tamrus' ability to quickly gather enemies, the team will start off with an optimal environment for dealing damage.

155.Detial: Olgath is a ranger with very high AoE damage output. As long as he can successfully cast his ultimate, Olgath will leap into the air and unleash a devastating barrage on enemies using scatter shells, shrapnel shells, and piercing shells.
155.FriendDetial: Joining a Hypogean team with Duskfeather - Maetria at its core greatly ensures Olgath's survival, allowing him to cast his ultimate and reap the rewards of battle.

156.Detial: Edwin can create Dominions. When allies within a Dominion take normal attack damage, the damage is reduced, Energy is recovered, and the attacker's Energy is reduced. This is a great way to counter formations that rely on normal attack damage. Edwin also periodically gains damage immunity and enters a state of Invincibility.
156.FriendDetial: Daimon can create a shield by pilfering the health of his enemies. Edwin's Dominions can reduce the normal attack damage he takes and restores his Energy, while enhancing Daimon's Tank attributes and damage-dealing capability.

157.Detial: When another hero is defeated, Duskfeather Maetria can absorb their attributes, leaving behind permanent Smoldering Flame that deals continuous damage to nearby enemies. She can also resurrect multiple times per battle. Surviving until the very end, she will have absorbed lots of attributes to end the game.
157.FriendDetial: Canisa & Ruke can gather enemies, causing them to take continuous damage from Duskfeather Maetria's embers. Canisa & Ruke's powerful survivability also buys enough time for Duskfeather Maetria to absorb attributes and resurrect.

158.Detial: Crassio can protect heroes deployed below him and grant them shields, while dealing massive AoE damage to and knocking back enemies around them.
158.FriendDetial: Safiya - Maestro of Power can conjure a Domain to provide a shield to allies and increase their Tenacity. When battling alongside Crassio, both can protect and provide buffs to one another.

159.Detial: Emilia casts ice magic to freeze enemies and creates a blessed zone to bless allies within its range, granting them continuous health and Energy recovery.
159.FriendDetial: Rem's damage output depends on the Demon Form she enters. Emilia can protect Rem when Demon Form is not activated and grant her Energy recovery, helping her remain in the Demon Form.

160.Detial: Rem can enter the Demon Form and deal damage that ignores shield effects and leeches enemies' health while stealing their Energy while she is in this state.
160.FriendDetial: Alna can immunize herself and another frontline hero to damage and control effects at regular intervals. When on the frontline together with Rem, she enhances Rem's survivability.

161.Detial: Athalia - Harbinger of Truth can traverse a battlefield and inflict damage on the three enemies with the highest Attack Rating with Ripping Slash. With her Divine Descent she creates a Judgment Sphere targeting and dealing damage to the enemy hero with the highest Attack Rating, knocking back other enemies, while refreshing the cooldown of Ripping Slash.
161.FriendDetial: Daemia can summon Torrid Wind. When an ally deals damage while Torrid Wind is active, Daemia launches follow-up attack, which can deal great damage to the enemy when combined with the high damage frequency of Athalia - Harbinger of Truth.

162.Detial: Ginneas is able to knock enemies into the air with his Burst Hammer, and can receive Fearless Shields and share them with allies. His Furniture Skill grants him Will of Steel, providing him with damage buffs and reduction while sharing it with allies who also carry Fearless Shields.
162.FriendDetial: Ginneas can generate a massive amount of shields which can provide additional effects, capable of charging Mountain's Strength of Brutus - Lion's Pride.

163.Detial: Daemia can summon different phenomena on the battlefield, and provide Dewy Nectar to allied heroes. With her Signature Item, she can grant an enormous Attack Rating buff and damage reduction to allied heroes possessing Dewy Nectar. While Torrid Wind is active, Daemia launches follow-up attacks together with allies possessing Dewy Nectar.
163.FriendDetial: Athalia - Harbinger of Truth can deal damage at a high frequency. While Torrid Wind is active and when possessing Dewy Nectar, she can frequently trigger Daemia to wield follow-up attacks.

165.Detial: Upon joining a battle, Safiya - Maestro of Power conjures an Obelisk Domain in the allied half of the battlefield, providing Tenacity boost and shield effects to allies within the Domain. Meanwhile, Burning Ambition distributes any of her excess Energy evenly to her allies.
165.FriendDetial: Safiya - Maestro of Power can conjure a Domain to provide a shield to allies and increase their Tenacity. When battling alongside Crassio, both can protect and provide buffs to one another.

166.Detial: Ivan's ultimate allows him to manipulate the allied hero with the highest Initial Attack Rating, granting them a powerful Spirit Shield. Ivan also grants Attack Rating, Haste and Energy Recovery to the manipulated ally for the duration of the shield, making him a Support hero that protects and empowers key damage dealers.
166.FriendDetial: Spark of Hope - Belinda is highly dependent on quickly casting her ultimate to decisively turn the tide, but she herself is rather fragile. Ivan happens to shore up her weaknesses and further amplify the power of her ultimate.

167.Detial: Naroko fights together with Nadia, her sand bug, who can absorb the essence of other fallen summons during battle to grow stronger and provide substantial healing to allies.
167.FriendDetial: Naroko and Maestro of Power - Safiya can grant shields and healing to their team, in order to secure a safe environment for the main damage dealers.

168.Detial: Lucilla's Crimson Scythe can randomly seal enemies' attributes. When casting her ultimate, she unveils the domain, granting the sealed attributes to allies. When fighting alongside Liberta, both of them are further strengthened.
168.FriendDetial: When fighting alongside Liberta, attributes are no longer sealed by Lucilla at random, greatly improving the reliability of the debuffs she inflicts on enemies.

169.Detial: Liberta can grant Blessing Orbs to allies to recover health, or Punishing Orbs to enemies to deal damage. His ultimate links one enemy and allied hero, evenly redistributing their health. When fighting alongside Lucilla, both their abilities are further enhanced.
169.FriendDetial: When fighting alongside Lucilla, if Liberta takes lethal damage, Lucilla will sacrifice one of her resurrections to negate the damage, making Liberta immune to damage and controls for a period of time, and giving Liberta more opportunity to deal damage.

170.Detial: The Dawnbringer - Lyca can delay the deployment of allies in the same row, avoiding the intense barrage at the start of battle. When activating her Awakening skill, The Dawnbringer - Lyca can also take on the role of main damage dealer, utilizing the chain damage of her normal attack to simultaneously target frontline and backline enemies.
170.FriendDetial: The Dawnbringer - Lyca's opening starfall arrow can limit enemies' Energy Recovery, ensuring your heroes cast their ultimates first. Combining with Daemia's ultimate can give your team the advantage early on.

171.Detial: Jerome casts Performance Evaluation on allied heroes at the start of battle, granting attribute bonuses to allies who raise their performance rating by dealing damage to enemies. When fighting alongside heroes of the Lightbearer Empire, these attribute bonuses will be further amplified.
171.FriendDetial: The Veiled Wind - Thane, with his high attack rate among the Lightbearer Empire's heroes, can quickly raise his performance rating at the start of battle to gain attribute bonuses and diminish enemies, which fits perfectly with Jerome's Performance Evaluation mechanism.

173.Detial: The Soulreaver - Shemira can pull out souls from enemy heroes to summon Ephemeral Spirits, which channels damage and empower allies' output. When allies die, Shemira can also delay their demise, allowing them to keep fighting for a while longer.
173.FriendDetial: Canisa & Ruke can draw enemies and reduce their Energy, which can frequently trigger The Soulreaver - Shemira's Ephemeral Spirit effect in battle to better coordinate AoE skills.
